newsitem.title: USA: Royal Standard to drill in Bousquet area.
newsitem.headline: Royal Standard to drill in Bousquet area.

text.p: Royal Standard Minerals Inc said Wednesday it planned to start drilling in mid-February after doing grid control and surface geophysics in the Bousquet, Quebec property.
The company said it will drill in the northern portion of the claim group, which adjoins Barrick Gold Corp's Bousquet mine on the south.

"Underground drilling from north to south in this area on to the northern portion of the RSM claim block indicates the presence of Bousquet mine host rocks, sulfide mineralization with gold mineralization at depth in this drill hole," it said.

"The drill target is a Bousquet-type gold deposit on the northern portion of the RSM claim block," it said. "RSM believes that the odds are excellent for returning Bousquet-type mineralization on its property."
